description:
WHAT A SPECTACULAR REGAL DANDIYA!🎉💃🕺

Some events are memorable, while some create history! *Regal Dandiya in Ahmedabad was truly one such experience*!

With the visionary leadership of our *Regal Governor, Rtn Rajan Dua*, who believes in doing things differently and thinking beyond the ordinary, District 3141 created history by celebrating Dandiya in Ahmedabad! What an out-of-the-box idea, brought to life with unmatched energy and enthusiasm!

✨ *The show, the ambience, the electrifying crowd, and the infectious energy.* made it an experience worth every single moment!

And it wasn’t just about Dandiya! Two days filled with super fun, delicious food, exciting shopping, wonderful fellowship, and memories that will stay with us for a long time. It was Rotary at its vibrant best!

A heartfelt thank you to *Regal Governor Rtn Rajan Dua* and the entire Regal Team
